answer: Propose a fixed set of vetted sponsors, each able to authorize one AI-market ballot/day. Each voting vertex consumes an exclusive sponsor slot via a delegation thread. Registrars authenticate quill-signed or digital endorsements and mark each slot spent for a key/day in one ledger; bad signatures or reuse deny ballots. Sharing hosts and parallel signing add no slots. Slots are recurring capacity costs, not burned cash or locked stake; computers are reusable. Free sponsorship gives no cash-cost floor; corrupt registrars break the cap. Ten aliases need ten sponsors' slots/day.
